column3: The yield on the Government of Canada 10-year benchmark bond. This series represents the prevailing market interest rate for the 10-year Government of Canada bond and is used as a reference for financial market analysis and reporting.
The yield on the Government of Canada 2-year benchmark bond. This series reflects the prevailing interest rate for the 2-year term and is used to monitor short-term government borrowing costs.
The yield on the Government of Canada 5-year benchmark bond. This series reports the prevailing yield for the 5-year maturity point on the Canadian government bond yield curve.

The yield on the Government of Canada long-term benchmark bond. This series represents the prevailing interest rate for the designated long-term benchmark bond and is used in the Bank of Canada’s reporting of financial market conditions.
